2608.18767.title: Gradient Mirage: Trainable yet Label-Unidentifiable Gradients in Large Language Model Split Learning
2608.18767.paper_summary: Gradient matching attacks (GMAs) in LLM split learning (SL) rely on a critical yet underexplored assumption: the gradient exposed at the split interface is a faithful derivative of the client's full-label training objective. This gradient-objective consistency allows a curious server to recover private labels by searching for a sequence whose induced gradient explains the observation. We propose Gradient Mirage, a defense that breaks this consistency without discarding the optimization utility of the backward signal. Our key idea is to induce the adversary to solve a misspecified inverse problem, in which no plausible label sequence in the sequence space can explain the observed gradients. Concretely, Gradient Mirage achieves this by inducing inconsistency across three dimensions: objective, direction, and scale. Selective Autoregressive Supervision derives the exposed gradient from a masked surrogate loss rather than the full-label objective assumed by the attacker; Scale Blinding then applies randomized multiplicative rescaling, obscuring the gradient's natural magnitude; and Directional Privatization further randomizes the gradient direction while preserving its magnitude through the von Mises-Fisher (vMF) mechanism under a directional metric differential privacy guarantee. Crucially, utility is preserved: the Top segment still learns from all target tokens via Dual-Track Backpropagation, the exposed gradient remains informative since each supervised token retains its complete autoregressive context, and Bottom-Gradient Recovery restores the effective gradient for Bottom-segment optimization. Extensive experiments show that Gradient Mirage provides substantially stronger protection than existing defenses under comparable fine-tuning performance, achieving a better privacy-utility trade-off.
2608.18767.paper_summary_zh: 梯度匹配攻擊（GMA）在大型語言模型（LLM）分割學習（SL）中依賴一個關鍵但尚未深入探討的假設：在分割介面暴露的梯度是客戶完整標籤訓練目標的真實導數。這種梯度-目標一致性使得好奇的伺服器能夠通過尋找一個序列來恢復私有標籤，該序列所誘導的梯度解釋了觀察結果。我們提出了梯度幻影（Gradient Mirage），這是一種防禦措施，打破了這種一致性，而不會放棄反向信號的優化效用。我們的關鍵想法是誘使對手解決一個錯誤指定的逆問題，在這個問題中，序列空間中不存在任何合理的標籤序列可以解釋觀察到的梯度。具體而言，梯度幻影通過在三個維度上誘導不一致性來實現這一點：目標、方向和規模。選擇性自回歸監督從掩碼的替代損失中推導出暴露的梯度，而不是攻擊者假設的完整標籤目標；然後，規模盲化應用隨機乘法重縮放，模糊了梯度的自然大小；而方向隱私化則進一步隨機化梯度方向，同時通過在方向度量差分隱私保證下的馮·米塞斯-費舍爾（vMF）機制保留其大小。關鍵是，效用得以保留：頂部段仍然通過雙軌反向傳播從所有目標標記中學習，暴露的梯度仍然具有信息性，因為每個受監督的標記保留其完整的自回歸上下文，而底部梯度恢復則恢復了底部段優化的有效梯度。大量實驗表明，梯度幻影在可比的微調性能下提供了比現有防禦措施更強的保護，實現了更好的隱私-效用權衡。
